abstract: Pancreatic cystic neoplasms (PCN) are common incidental findings and represent the only known precursor lesions of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) that can be detected and monitored using conventional imaging. The different entities of PCNs vary considerably in terms of their potential for malignant transformation. Mucinous cysts are regarded as precancerous lesions, whereas serous PCN are considered benign. The most common type of PCN are intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasms (IPMNs), which are subdivided into main-duct and branch-duct IPMNs. Magnetic resonance imaging is regarded as the gold standard for diagnosis and is complemented by endosonography, which offers high local image resolution in cases of discrepant findings or suspected worrisome features (e.g., intramural nodules). Laboratory analysis of cyst fluid can assist in identifying the type of cyst in cases of diagnostic uncertainty. The current Kyoto guideline provides detailed recommendations on surgical management and surveillance intervals for PCNs. Despite these recommendations and improved imaging modalities, the clinical management of predominantly asymptomatic patients remains challenging, and individually tailored monitoring and treatment decisions are often necessary in the context of the patient's age, comorbidities, personal preferences, the costs of long-term surveillance, and the morbidity and mortality associated with pancreatic surgery. The ultimate goal is to avoid overtreatment while ensuring that high-risk lesions are surgically resected in a timely manner.
key_points_ko: 췌장 낭성 종양(PCN)은 췌장암(PDAC)의 유일하게 발견 및 모니터링 가능한 전구 병변입니다.
가장 흔한 PCN은 주관형 및 분지관형으로 나뉘는 췌관내 유두상 점액성 종양(IPMN)입니다.
자기공명영상(MRI)은 진단의 표준 검사이며 내시경초음파가 보완적 역할을 합니다.
summary_ko: 췌장 낭성 종양(PCN, pancreatic cystic neoplasms)은 흔하게 우연히 발견되며 췌장암(PDAC, pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma)의 유일한 전구 병변입니다. 낭종의 종류에 따라 악성 전환 가능성이 다르며, 점액성 낭종은 전암성이고 장성 PCN은 양성으로 간주됩니다. 자기공명영상(MRI, magnetic resonance imaging)은 진단의 표준 검사이며 내시경초음파(endosonography)가 이를 보완합니다. 교토 가이드라인(Kyoto guideline)은 수술 관리 및 추적 관찰 간격에 대한 권고사항을 제공합니다.
title: [What is established in the management of pancreatic cysts?]
title_ko: 췌장 낭종 관리에서 확립된 것은 무엇인가?
